title: Key stage 4 performance by local authority district, 2023/24
description: DfE key stage 4 (GCSE) headline measures for academic year 2023/24 in England: Attainment 8, Progress 8, English and maths basics and EBacc, at national, regional and local authority district level.

files.note: 308 rows x 35 columns from the Explore Education Statistics "Key stage 4 performance" release, filtered before download and renamed locally: time_period 202324, version Revised, level_methodology Pupil residency, establishment_type_group State-funded schools (LA).
